raw_answer_text:
Looking at the validator errors, the issue is clear: the `block` genre does not use the `node` keyword to declare elements. Based on the documentation indicating that `block` is a scene genre with its own domain-specific keywords, the correct syntax uses `block` instead of `node`.

The five connections are all valid as-is, but the element declarations need to change from `node` to `block`.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown

figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal Job"
block caclient "CA Client"
block ca "Certificate Authority"
block deployagent "Deploy Agent"
block service "Service"

scheduler -> renewaljob
renewaljob -> caclient
caclient -> ca
renewaljob -> deployagent
deployagent -> service
```

The key change: **`node` → `block`** for all element declarations in the `block` genre. The rest of the syntax remains unchanged — the connections and title were already correct.
